scope: default plugin preset activation and new chat engine attachment
status: implemented and isolated regression passed; root integration/persistence pending
changes: Explicit startup activation selects Tisya through the existing protected native refresh, retaining connection and sampling settings.
Same-release saved prompt edits are selected without rewriting. Concurrent update cannot swallow a later activation request.
Current chat binds via a serialized, scoped ensureBound service. Existing states are not reset; missing or corrupt owned data reports a concrete failure.
New attachment marks existing visible history as baseline. A pending owner marker supports safe recovery after metadata/storage failures.
New chat openings enable the engine. Repeated ready calls in the same opening preserve a deliberate disable; switching away and back enables again.
No user identity or role is selected implicitly.
Preset startup failure and catalog failure support explicit retry without automatic retry loops.
ensureDatabase uses the same ensureBound owner and cannot turn missing saved data into a new blank state.

preserved_failures.finding: Happy DOM fixture selectedOptions retained stale selection after changing value. Fixture now observes options[selectedIndex], matching selected value; no production fallback was added.
A concurrent in-progress identity UI change declared const mode twice. Its owner fixed it; the subsequent full relevant suite passed.
